summary: No work-count omission identified at the external cuSPARSE API contract boundary. Adjacent monotone MPI row boundaries cover [0,numRows), and corresponding nonzero boundaries are the global CSR offsets at those exact row boundaries. Distribution retains every local row offset including its sentinel and every corresponding value/column; all local offsets are rebased, while every rank receives the entire dense input vector. GpuSpmv builds a localRows-by-numRows CSR descriptor for all local nonzeros, zero-based 32-bit indices, double values and full-sized dense descriptors. Each nonempty rank submits non-transpose double CSR SpMV with alpha=1 and beta=0 once per requested timed iteration, with stream synchronization before ending MPI_Wtime. Actual compiled callee and count loop preserve these calls, not merely final output equality. Empty-row ranks have no mathematical rows to compute and legitimately skip library calls.
